title: Whispered Domination (ORIGINAL)
description: With each command I whisper. With each shackle of words I lock around you. Finding them giving you a sense of purpose. A thrill of pleasure. "Deeper," I whisper, and Deeper you fall. Spinning in the enchanting spiral that is my voice. Every loop of my words, a chain of my command, which only draws you closer, only binds you tighter. You were born to serve, to submit, to surrender to my will. This is your sanctuary, your reality. A beautiful realm spun out from my caring domination. Here you are my precious toy, my beloved pet. Here each word becomes another command that you follow, should I choose to whisper it in your mind- "My Sweet Pet. Drop. Deeper," echoing, in a resonant thrum that makes you shiver. Oh, I have you hanging on a thread, my darling. Are you ready to dance at my command? Custom Audio(Sorry loves, but personalised customs for this particular file are now closed alongside the free giveaway). For those interested in how such customised audios are made please check out my subreddit over on r/ShibbySays for more info. Congrats to Steppy! With ninety acceptable entries, I used a random number generator to find the winner, and their prompt won the chance at receiving a custom version. However, don't worry if you missed out this time, I may also open up for similar customs on future files where I feel it is appropriate.
author: Mistress Shibby
